_comment: vLLM local dev template — the sanctioned local dev endpoint case. http is accepted here ONLY because the host is loopback AND allow_insecure is true; keysmith refuses non-loopback http base URLs because they would send your bearer key in cleartext. Set VLLM_API_KEY to any nonempty string (vLLM ignores it unless started with --api-key). Adjust the port and model ids to your vLLM server.
